description: A floating pill in the bottom-right corner shows how much of your coding-plan quota is left: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor through bb's own collectors, plus GLM (Z.AI) and Kimi Code fetched directly. One ring per limit window, follows the open thread's harness, inline per-provider refresh, a two-column popup with Refresh-all, and a manual mode that makes no background requests at all. Requires BB 0.46+.
